prompt: Which statement is suitable for the revised customer summary?
promptZh: 哪項陳述適合放入修改後的客戶摘要？

options.text: The receiver recorded no alerts from 10:00 to 10:20; coverage from 09:40 to 10:00 was unconfirmed.
options.zh: 10:00 到 10:20 接收器未收到警示；09:40 到 10:00 的監測連線未確認。
options.whyZh: Fern 從 09:40 開始，直到 10:00 的連線未確認；10:00 到 10:20 確認連線且未收到任何警示。

options.text: The receiver recorded two alerts from 09:40 to 10:20.
options.zh: 09:40 到 10:20 接收器收到兩則警示。
options.whyZh: 兩則是 09:00 到 09:30 的紀錄，在 Fern 開始之前，不能移用。

options.text: No alerts were sent at any point during Job Fern.
options.zh: Fern 工作執行期間，沒有任何警示被送出。
options.whyZh: 較早部分沒有確認連線；能證實的是較晚的連線區間內接收器未收到警示，而非裝置整段都沒發出。

options.text: The receiver recorded zero alerts throughout the two intervals from 09:30 to 10:20.
options.zh: 09:30 到 10:20 的兩個區間內，接收器都沒有收到警示。
options.whyZh: 破折號表示連線未確認，不是零；而 Fern 也要到 09:40 才開始。

explanationZh: Fern 從 09:40 開始，直到 10:00 的連線未確認；10:00 到 10:20 確認連線且未收到任何警示。
evidence: Job Fern ran from 09:40 to 10:20. / 09:30–10:00 | No confirmed connection recorded; count —. / 10:00–10:20 | Receiver connected throughout; count 0. / State the period we actually checked and what the receiver got during that period.

vocabulary.note: 缺乏可證實連線的紀錄，不等於確定離線或確定未發警示。
